description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Integrating REWET into R2D for Flexible Restoration and Functionality Assessment of a Damaged Water Distribution Networks is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sina Naeimi Dafchahi, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). The Restoration Tool for Water Network after Event (REWET) is a standalone tool for the functionality and resiliency assessment of water networks following events. It incorporates restoration efforts made postevent to restore the system’s functionality to the consumers. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-c1zt-sy71. Keywords: NHERI REWET SIMCENTER R2D WATER. Published 2024-07-01. Facility named: SimCenter. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
